altitudeInMeters.description: The altitude, in meters, that the printer is located at.

building.description: The building that the printer is located in.

city.description: The city that the printer is located in.

countryOrRegion.description: The country or region that the printer is located in.

floor.description: The floor that the printer is located on. Only numerical values are supported right now.

floorDescription.description: The description of the floor that the printer is located on.

latitude.description: The latitude that the printer is located at.

longitude.description: The longitude that the printer is located at.

organization.description: The organizational hierarchy that the printer belongs to. The elements should be in hierarchical order.

postalCode.description: The postal code that the printer is located in.

roomDescription.description: The description of the room that the printer is located in.

roomName.description: The room that the printer is located in. Only numerical values are supported right now.

site.description: The site that the printer is located in.

stateOrProvince.description: The state or province that the printer is located in.

streetAddress.description: The street address where the printer is located.

subdivision.description: The subdivision that the printer is located in. The elements should be in hierarchical order.
